verdict.rationale: No native batch or bulk endpoint is documented. Bulk work is only possible indirectly: the CLI can be called from scripts with JMESPath field extraction, and the SDK supports async calls that could be fanned out across many products. Agentic search splitting a query into sub-searches is a single-query feature, not a bulk operation. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API (e.g., multi-URL extract or bulk price-tracking subscription), bulk-operation docs or limits, and any hands-on corroboration of high-volume use.
